items.stem: Find ∫ (6x + 1/x² + 2/x³) dx.
items.markingKey: (c) 3x² − 1/x − 1/x² + C. Use ∫xⁿ dx = xⁿ⁺¹/(n + 1) + C, n ≠ −1, term by term.

items.stem: Bag I contains 7 black and 8 green balls, and Bag II contains 4 black and 7 green balls. One bag is chosen at random and a ball drawn from it is black. Find the probability that it was drawn from Bag I.
items.markingKey: (a) 77/137. P(E₁) = P(E₂) = 1/2; P(A|E₁) = 7/15, P(A|E₂) = 4/11; P(A) = 137/330 by total probability; Bayes: P(E₁|A) = 77/137.

items.stem: Is the function f(x) = −x for x ≤ 4, f(x) = −2x + 2 for x > 4 continuous at x = 4? Justify.
items.markingKey: (c) LHL = f(4) = −4; RHL = −6; unequal, so discontinuous.

items.stem: Find the corner points of the feasible region determined by x + 5y ≤ 35, 2x + 4y ≤ 40, x ≥ 0, y ≥ 0.
items.markingKey: (c) (0, 0), (0, 7), (10, 5), (20, 0). Intercepts of the boundary lines and their intersection (10, 5); keep points satisfying all constraints.

items.stem: Solve the system of equations −2x − 3y = 2, x − y = 9 by the matrix method.
Find the angle between the vectors 6î + 6ĵ + 7k̂ and −5î + 14ĵ + 2k̂.
Find the angle between the lines (x − 3)/11 = (y + 3)/−2 = (z − 2)/10 and (x − 1)/−14 = y/−2 = (z + 1)/−5.
Find two positive numbers whose sum is 12 and whose product is maximum.
Find the transpose of A = [6, 3, 6; −1, −1, 5] and write its order.
items.markingKey: (b) Aᵀ = [6, −1; 3, −1; 6, 5], order 3 × 2. Rows of A become columns of Aᵀ.

items.stem: How many symmetric relations can be defined in the set A = {a, b, c, d, e}?
items.markingKey: (c) 2¹⁵ = 32768. Choose freely the 5 diagonal pairs and the 10 unordered pairs {a, b}: 2¹⁵ = 32768.

items.stem: A fair die with faces numbered 1 to 10 is rolled. Let X be the number shown. Find E(X).
Find dy/dx at the point (3, 2) for the curve 2x² − xy + 2y² = 20.
items.markingKey: (b) −2. Differentiate: 4x − (y + x dy/dx) + 4y dy/dx = 0 ⇒ dy/dx = −(4x − y)/(−x + 4y); at (3, 2): −2.

items.stem: Solve the differential equation dy/dx = y/x + 2y²/x², x ≠ 0.
items.markingKey: y = vx: x dv/dx = 2v² ⇒ dv/v² = 2 dx/x ⇒ −1/v = 2 log|x| + C.

items.stem: Find x if the determinant of [−2, −1, −1; 2, 3, −3; x, 0, 0] is 0.
items.markingKey: Expanding, the determinant equals 6x + 0 = 0 ⇒ x = 0.

items.stem: Find the direction cosines of the vector −5î − 14ĵ + 2k̂.
items.markingKey: Divide each component by |a⃗| = 15.

items.stem: The Cartesian equation of a line is (x − 3)/5 = (y − 1)/−4 = (1 − z)/−1. Write its vector equation and its direction ratios.
items.markingKey: Rewrite (1 − z)/−1 as (z − 1) (1 mark); read off the point and direction (1 mark).

items.stem: Find the area of the region bounded by the curve x² = 8y and the line 8y = 2x.
items.markingKey: Intersection: x² = 2x ⇒ x = 0, 2; area = (1/8)∫ from 0 to 2 of (2x − x²) dx = 1/6.

items.stem: A ladder 5 m long leans against a wall. Its foot is pulled along the ground away from the wall at 1/2 m/s. How fast is its top sliding down the wall when the foot is 3 m from the wall?
items.markingKey: x² + y² = 25 ⇒ 2x dx/dt + 2y dy/dt = 0 (1 mark); at x = 3, y = 4: dy/dt = −(3/4)(1/2) = −3/8 m/s, i.e. the top slides down at 3/8 m/s (2 marks).

items.stem: If A = [−1, 0; 4, 3], find the values of x and y such that A² + xA + yI = O.
items.markingKey: A² = [1, 0; 8, 9] (1 mark); compare entries of A² + xA + yI with O (1 mark): x = −2, y = −3 (1 mark).

items.stem: Determine whether the relation R = {(x, y): x is the father of y} in the set of people of a town is reflexive, symmetric or transitive. Justify your answer.
items.answer: R is neither reflexive nor symmetric nor transitive
items.markingKey: No one is their own father; if x is father of y, y is not father of x; a grandfather is not the father. (1 mark for each property).

items.stem: Find ∫ x⁴ log x dx.
items.markingKey: By parts with u = log x, dv = xⁿ dx.

items.stem: Bag I contains 4 blue and 7 white balls, and Bag II contains 6 blue and 5 white balls. A bag is chosen at random and one ball is drawn. Find the probability that the ball is blue.
items.markingKey: Theorem of total probability: ½(4/11) + ½(6/11) = 5/11.

items.stem: Find a and b such that f(x) = −8 for x ≤ −2, f(x) = ax + b for −2 < x < 7, and f(x) = 28 for x ≥ 7 is a continuous function.
items.markingKey: Continuity at x = −2: −2a + b = −8 (1 mark); at x = 7: 7a + b = 28 (1 mark); solving, a = 4, b = 0 (1 mark).

items.stem: Maximise Z = 15x + 15y subject to 4x + 2y ≤ 12, 3x + 3y ≤ 12, x ≥ 0, y ≥ 0. Comment on the optimal solution.
items.answer: Maximum Z = 60 at both (0, 4) and (2, 2), hence at every point of the segment joining them (infinitely many optimal solutions)
items.markingKey: Corner values 0, 60, 60, 45 (3 marks); equal maxima at two adjacent corners ⇒ multiple optima (2 marks).

items.stem: Find the particular solution of dy/dx = y/x + 3x/y, x > 0, given y = 1 when x = 1.
items.markingKey: Put y = vx (1 mark); v dv = 3 dx/x ⇒ y²/x² = 6 log x + C (2 marks); C = 1 (1 mark); answer (1 mark).

items.stem: Given that A = [−2, 1, 0; −2, −1, 3; 2, −1, −2] and B = [5, 2, 3; 2, 4, 6; 4, 0, 4] satisfy AB = −8I, find A⁻¹ and use it to solve −2x + y = −6; −2x − y + 3z = −11; 2x − y − 2z = 12.
items.markingKey: AB = −8I ⇒ A⁻¹ = B/−8 (2 marks); X = A⁻¹C (2 marks); values (1 mark).

items.stem: Let a⃗ = 3î + ĵ − 5k̂ and b⃗ = 2î + ĵ + 3k̂. Find a unit vector perpendicular to both a⃗ + b⃗ and a⃗ − b⃗, and verify that (a⃗ + b⃗) × (a⃗ − b⃗) = −2(a⃗ × b⃗).
items.markingKey: a⃗ + b⃗ and a⃗ − b⃗ (1 mark); cross product (2 marks); unit vector (1 mark); verification (1 mark).

items.stem: Two straight metal rods in Aditi's sculpture lie along lines with direction ratios 10, 2, 11 and −9, −6, 2. (i) Find the direction cosines of the first rod. (ii) Find the cosine of the angle between the rods. (iii) Are the rods perpendicular? Justify.
items.markingKey: (i) 1 mark (ii) 2 marks (iii) 1 mark.

items.stem: Ishita, an architect in Mysuru, designs an arch window bounded by the curve y = 6x − x² and the x-axis (units in metres). (i) Find where the curve meets the x-axis. (ii) Write the integral for the area of the window. (iii) Find the area of the glass needed.
items.answer: (i) x = 0 and x = 6 (ii) ∫ from 0 to 6 of (6x − x²) dx (iii) 36 m²
items.markingKey: (i) 1 mark (ii) 1 mark (iii) 2 marks.
